source_doc_refs.consumption_role: Defines mandatory research preregistration, single frozen test, evidence integrity, and ledger-trigger rules.
Defines minimal_data_burst as research / paper only and limits A-share burst inputs to OHLCV, turnover, benchmark, liquidity, limit / halt, and existing candidate context.
Defines CSI1000 as the provisional primary benchmark and CSI300 as mandatory secondary context for A-share minimal-data burst reporting.
Separates this A-share alpha-validation preregistration from US provider access, sample validation, and SEC parser feasibility.
Routes the current P0 task to alpha measurement integrity and blocks this preregistration until corrected-basis supersession.

hypothesis_registration.hypothesis_text: A single frozen A-share minimal-data burst trigger using existing A-short candidate context, EOD momentum / breakout / amount expansion, liquidity and limit-state filters will show positive 5-trading-day cost-adjusted excess return versus CSI1000 over the frozen 2024-2025 monthly cohort window. The result can only decide whether to continue research; it cannot promote production use or ship-gate evidence.
hypothesis_registration.data_window_at_registration: Frozen historical monthly candidate cohorts from 20240131 through 20251231 under result/a_short/backtest/generated/*/candidates.csv. Current 202605 live-style outputs may be inspected for input compatibility only, not included in the promotion-relevant statistic.
hypothesis_registration.evidence_available_at_registration: Known A-short v7.10 24-period production results include an uncorrected 5d excess_csi1000 positive clue and non-significant 20d evidence. The 5d clue is now treated as measurement-contaminated until same-anchor corrected revalidation proves otherwise. No burst-specific parameter search has been run under this preregistration.

eligibility_rule: Use only rows already present in the frozen A-short generated candidate files; do not regenerate candidate universes inside this test.
Require chasing_high == false, overheat_flag == false, has_crash_veto == false, and is_lock == false where columns are present.
exclusion_rule: Exclude rows with missing ts_code, trade date, close, pct_5d, avg_amount_5d, avg_amount_20d, is_breakout, or tier.
Exclude rows whose T+1 entry is unbuyable due to limit-up; record the unbuyable count and rate.
Do not add sector, theme, manual catalyst, capital-flow, or full-data burst fields in this test.

data_window.cohort_frequency: monthly generated A-short candidate cohorts only
data_window.outcome_data_ref: existing A-share EOD forward-return surface used by runners/backtest_rank.py; no new provider fetch is authorized by this artifact
lookahead_prevention_notes: Use each cohort's existing as_of candidate file as the decision snapshot.
Use T+1 entry and T+5 exit prices after the as_of date only for outcome calculation.
Do not let later 2026 live-style outputs affect the 2024-2025 promotion-relevant statistic.

hard_filters: entry_flag must equal 可直接观察.
chasing_high, overheat_flag, has_crash_veto, and is_lock must be false where present.
signal_definition: All three positive signal families must pass; no alternate thresholds or fallback families are allowed in this test.
trigger_rule.portfolio_construction_rule: Equal-weight all passing rows in each monthly cohort; if more than 10 rows pass, take the top 10 by final_score with ts_code as the deterministic tie-breaker. Empty cohorts are recorded as zero-signal cohorts and are not backfilled.

entry_exit_rule.entry_rule: Enter at T+1 open using qfq-adjusted open, matching runners/backtest_rank.py T+1 semantics.
entry_exit_rule.exit_rule: Exit at T+5 close using qfq-adjusted close; no stop, profit-take, re-entry, or holding-period alternative is allowed in this test.
entry_exit_rule.cost_model: Subtract 0.16 percentage points round-trip cost from stock return before CSI1000 excess calculation.
entry_exit_rule.unbuyable_entry_handling: If T+1 open is at or near up-limit under existing stk_limit or board fallback logic, skip that row and record pending_no_entry_limit_up; do not replace it with another row.

benchmark_rule.benchmark_return_rule: Compute CSI1000 close-to-close return over the same T+1 entry date through T+5 exit date; missing benchmark windows fail the affected row instead of zero-filling.

criteria.failure_action: Treat the result as underpowered and do not continue this trigger without a new preregistration.
Do not continue this trigger as an alpha candidate; at most record it as exploratory.
Treat drawdown behavior as failing the burst research continuation gate.
Treat A-share limit-risk feasibility as failing the burst research continuation gate.
Treat the result as month-clustered and non-robust.

test_budget.test_budget_consumption_rule: Running the frozen trigger against the frozen 2024-2025 monthly cohorts consumes the single promotion-relevant test. Changing any threshold, universe, benchmark, holding period, ranking cap, entry / exit rule, cost model, or pass/fail criterion requires a singleton program-level ledger first.
disallowed_without_ledger: Changing from all-pass conjunction to a score or weighted rank.
Using CSI300 diagnostics to rescue a failing CSI1000 result.
Adding catalyst, capital-flow, sector, concept, manual evidence, or full-data burst fields.

evidence_integrity_plan.multiple_testing_notes: This artifact allows one frozen test only. Multiple-testing adjustment is not applicable unless a second promotion-relevant degree of freedom is introduced, in which case the program-level ledger trigger fires before the work runs.

ledger_allowed_locations_if_triggered: independent singleton research test-budget ledger artifact
trigger_events: Any search over pct_5d, amount-expansion, liquidity, breakout, rank-cap, cost, benchmark, or holding-period thresholds.
Any attempt to treat CSI300 diagnostics as a pass/fail benchmark.
Any full-data burst field addition before the frozen test is reported.
Any production promotion or evidence report that would depend on more than this one frozen result.

next_steps: BLOCKED_DO_NOT_RUN: this preregistration must not be run until a corrected-basis superseding preregistration replaces the benchmark entry-basis rule; the current benchmark rule is blocked by a measurement-basis issue.
After corrected-basis supersession exists, run only the superseding frozen research-only falsification test, or stop.
Write a research-only evidence report that points research_experiment_log.hypothesis_registration_ref to the corrected-basis superseding preregistration.

If this in-sample frozen test passes, register and run a separate confirmation path before any production promotion: at minimum 2026+ held-out / forward cohorts or 12 months live-normalized forward evidence under the unchanged trigger. This preregistration does not authorize promotion without that confirmation.
If the frozen test passes all thresholds, the only allowed outcome is research_continue_only with later schema review, Claude review, and user approval.
If any threshold fails, record falsified_or_redesign_required and do not tune thresholds without first creating a singleton program-level test-budget ledger.
limitations: BLOCKED_DO_NOT_RUN: the current benchmark_return_rule uses benchmark close basis against stock T+1 open entry semantics and is not executable as promotion-relevant research-continuation evidence.

A corrected-basis supersession may change only benchmark / entry-anchor basis; changing trigger thresholds, universe, holding period, cost model, criteria, or test_budget requires a singleton program-level ledger first.
This is minimal-data EOD research, not full-data burst evidence.
It does not use dated catalysts, filings, capital-flow, options, borrow, or manual confirmation evidence.
It is in-sample research over existing generated cohorts and cannot count as live-normalized or ship-gate evidence.
It does not authorize provider access, data fetch, runner changes, production strategy changes, minimal live observation, or full-size manual use.
